name: Neura 4NE1 Gen 4
description: The fourth generation of **Neura Robotics**' 4NE1 humanoid, unveiled on **23 October 2026**. It is **20% lighter** than its predecessor, with a slimmer body and a black textile outer skin, and runs the **Neuron** AI foundation model. It is operating at **Neura Gyms**, where companies train and test applications. Serial production is stated as the intent, not yet achieved.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body:
Gen 4 is the first 4NE1 that Neura describes as **20% lighter** than the generation before it. It has a slimmer body and a black textile outer skin, and it runs Neura's **Neuron** AI foundation model. Neura is showing it working at **Neura Gyms**, facilities where companies train and test applications on the robot, which is how the company is collecting use cases ahead of production. Neura states serial production as the goal; it has not announced a start date.

Earlier generations were listed at 170 cm, 60 kg and a 20 kg payload. Those figures describe earlier generations only and are **not applied to Gen 4**, which is explicitly lighter and has no published figures of its own. No official GitHub organization was found for Neura, so the humanoids table shows no account rather than a zero.
